title: Purchasing Note: Insert and Hardware Matching for Rebuilt Units — Factory Production Orders
content:
**Note.** For Factory Production Orders, insert matching adds business days to the rebuild of a customer specification remake as well: a grilles-between-glass change order on the window contract the order builds adds **2 business days**, a hardware finish change order without any grilles-between-glass change order adds **1 business day**, and neither adds nothing.

The days form part of the remake lead, counted in whole business days (Monday through Friday, excluding U.S. federal holidays) from the rebuild start date; the end of that lead is the remake revised ship date.

## Records read

The change orders on the Window Replacement Contracts contract that the order builds, by their kind: grilles between glass, hardware finish.

## Combinations

| Grilles-between-glass change order | Hardware finish change order | Days added |
|---|---|---|
| present | present | 2 |
| present | absent | 2 |
| absent | present | 1 |
| absent | absent | none |

## Hypothetical case

A contract with two hardware finish change orders written on different dates, and no grilles-between-glass change order, adds 1 business day.
